content:
## 题目
Let \(A=\begin{bmatrix}1&3&1&1\\0&1&2&-2\\-1&-2&1&-3\end{bmatrix}\). Find a pair of vectors \(\vec u,\vec v\in\mathbb R^4\) that span the set of all \(\vec x\in\mathbb R^4\) mapped to the zero vector by \(\vec x\mapsto A\vec x\).

## 解法
Linear space solution. The field is \(\mathbb R\).

Let \(T:\mathbb R^4\to\mathbb R^3\) be \(T(\vec x)=A\vec x\). We need \(\ker T\). For \(\vec x=(x_1,x_2,x_3,x_4)\), the condition \(T(\vec x)=\vec0\) is

\[
\begin{cases}
x_1+3x_2+x_3+x_4=0,\\
x_2+2x_3-2x_4=0,\\
-x_1-2x_2+x_3-3x_4=0.
\end{cases}
\]

The third equation is redundant because
\[
(-1,-2,1,-3)=-(1,3,1,1)+(0,1,2,-2).
\]
Thus it suffices to solve the first two equations.

From the second equation,
\[
x_2=-2x_3+2x_4.
\]
Substitute into the first equation:
\[
x_1+3(-2x_3+2x_4)+x_3+x_4=0
\]
so
\[
x_1=5x_3-7x_4.
\]
Therefore every solution is
\[
\vec x=
\begin{bmatrix}
5x_3-7x_4\\
-2x_3+2x_4\\
x_3\\
x_4
\end{bmatrix}
=
x_3
\begin{bmatrix}
5\\
-2\\
1\\
0
\end{bmatrix}
+
x_4
\begin{bmatrix}
-7\\
2\\
0\\
1
\end{bmatrix}.
\]
Hence
\[
\ker T=\operatorname{span}\left\{
\begin{bmatrix}5\\-2\\1\\0\end{bmatrix},
\begin{bmatrix}-7\\2\\0\\1\end{bmatrix}
\right\}.
\]

## 约定
Free variables chosen: \(x_3,x_4\).  
\(\vec u\) corresponds to \((x_3,x_4)=(1,0)\); \(\vec v\) corresponds to \((x_3,x_4)=(0,1)\).

来源：自行选取

## 答案
\[
\vec u=
\begin{bmatrix}
5\\
-2\\
1\\
0
\end{bmatrix},
\qquad
\vec v=
\begin{bmatrix}
-7\\
2\\
0\\
1
\end{bmatrix}.
\]

## 可核对结论
- 类型：基
- 结论：5 | -2 | 1 | 0 | -7 | 2 | 0 | 1
- 约定：\(\vec u\) 取 \((x_3,x_4)=(1,0)\)，\(\vec v\) 取 \((0,1)\)
- 约定来源：自行选取

## 检验
Substitution gives
\[
A\vec u=\begin{bmatrix}0\\0\\0\end{bmatrix},
\qquad
A\vec v=\begin{bmatrix}0\\0\\0\end{bmatrix}.
\]
The third row functional is \(-1\) times the first plus the second, while the first two row functionals are independent, so \(\operatorname{rank}T=2\). By rank-nullity,
\[
\dim\ker T=4-2=2.
\]
Since \(\vec u,\vec v\) are also independent, they span the whole kernel.

【题目】
Let A=\left[\begin{array}{cccc} 1 &3 &1 &1\cr 0 &1 &2 &-2\cr-1 &-2 &1 &-3 \end{array}\right]. Find a pair of vectors $\vec{u}, \vec{v}$ in ${\mathbb R}^4$ that span the set of all $\vec{x}\in {\mathbb R}^4$ that are mapped into the zero vector by the transformation $\vec{x} \mapsto A\vec{x}$.
$\vec{u}=$ \begin {array}{c} [ANS] \\ [ANS] \\ [ANS] \\ [ANS] \end{array}, $\vec{v}=$ \begin {array}{c} [ANS] \\ [ANS] \\ [ANS] \\ [ANS] \end{array}.

In the section 可核对结论, the line starting with 结论 must contain only the [ANS] values in order, separated by ' | '. Do not add words on that line.

【写法】
必须使用线性空间解法，不要改用矩阵解法。题目原文若要求另一种，仍以这里的指定为准。
